title: Sigil manifest
description: Sigil v1.0 manifest (sigil.yaml). Single source of truth for pack -> sign -> publish -> update.

LocalizedText.description: Either a plain string (treated as English) or a { "en": ..., "uk": ... } map. An `en` entry is required (SIG0290).

Parameters.description: Install-time / pack-time parameter declarations consumed by the wrapper installer (Sprint 5c).

screen.description: Optional wizard page label. Parameters that share a screen value are grouped onto the same Install Options screen in the wrapper installer. Parameters without a screen value land on a default 'Install Options' page after all named screens.

source.description: Dynamic options source. The wizard fetches `url` at install time, parses JSON, and populates a ComboBox with the items at `items_path` keyed by `value_property` / labelled by `label_property`.

InstallStep.description: A single declarative install step. Per-type parameter shapes are validated by the typed deserializer (Sprint 5c, Task 9), not in JSON Schema.

InstallerOption.description: Built-in configurable installer component: shorthand boolean or an object.

FileAssociationOption.description: file_associations component: shorthand boolean or an object with extensions.

CustomComponent.description: An app-defined custom option component (P10, gap G11) — the declarative equivalent of an Inno Setup [Tasks] entry. Generates no install step of its own; it surfaces as a checkbox that seeds option.<name> in the expression engine, which the author references from the `when` of the steps they want it to gate. Overridden on the CLI via the namespaced /Poption.<name>=true|false form.

name.description: The component key — a bare identifier, unique among components and not colliding with a built-in component or a declared parameter (SIG0300). Referenced as option.<name> in step `when` clauses.

label.description: The checkbox caption (localizable — a plain string or an { en: ..., de: ... } map).

description.description: Optional secondary caption shown under the checkbox (localizable).

locked.description: When true the row renders disabled and is always applied at its default; a CLI override is ignored (logged).

when.description: Optional applicability gate (a `when`-grammar expression). When it evaluates false the row is hidden and option.<name> resolves to false. May reference param.* / scope / system.* but not var.* (v1).

Prerequisite.description: A single prerequisite unit (P5, gap G6): detect → acquire → run → re-detect. Not journaled; never rolled back.

name.description: Human label shown on the wizard progress row and in the log ('Installing <name>…').

detect.description: A `when`-grammar expression that is true when the prerequisite is ALREADY satisfied (typically a registry_read / file_version / registry_exists check). Evaluated before install (skip if true) and again after (fail if still false).

source.description: The installer to run when detect is false: a payload://… path (bundled in the package) or an https://… URL (downloaded at install time). Args may use {var.*} / {install_dir} tokens.

sha256.description: SHA-256 integrity checksum (hex). REQUIRED for an https:// source (a download without it is refused, SIG0280); ignored for a payload:// source.

args.description: Arguments passed to the source installer (typically /quiet /norestart).

exit_codes_ok.description: Exit codes treated as success; defaults to [0]. An accepted code of 3010 additionally flags reboot-required.

scope_required.description: Requires the install to run in this scope; a mismatch with the resolved scope is a diagnostic at session start. Omit to accept any scope.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional per-prerequisite run timeout, in seconds.

HookPhase.description: An ordered list of lifecycle-hook steps (P2). Runs outside the rollback journal; each step is governed only by its own `on_failure` (no rollback obligations — see installer.hooks).

on_failure.description: Hook failure policy. `fail` aborts the operation; `continue` logs and proceeds. Default: fail for pre_* phases, continue for post_* phases. (`rollback` is not meaningful for a hook — it is treated as `fail`.)

InstallerScreen.description: A declared custom wizard screen (form over declared parameters).

ScreenField.description: A screen field: a bare parameter-name string or a { param, widget } object.

spec.description: Manifest schema version. Pinned to v1.0 for the MVP.

publisher.description: Display name or X.500 distinguished name (CN=...).

source.description: Path (relative to manifest) to the directory whose contents will be packaged.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to source) to include. Defaults to ['**/*'].

exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to source) to exclude.

deterministic.description: Reproducible build: sort entries, fixed mtimes, no host metadata.

publisher.description: X.500 distinguished name; must match the signing cert subject.

logo.description: Path to a master logo (PNG, square). Sigil will resize for tiles.

runWack.description: If true, run the Windows App Certification Kit (appcert.exe) against the packed MSIX. Emits SIG0111 (warning) when WACK isn't installed and SIG0112 (error) when WACK reports failures. WBS 2.9.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the PFX password.

deltaTargets.description: How many previous versions to generate delta patches against.

signingKey.description: Path to an Ed25519 private key (PEM) used to sign the update manifest.

installer.description: Branded Windows installer wizard config. Tokens are emitted at pack time by BrandTokenEmitter; WCAG-AA contrast is enforced against white text.

icon.description: Path (relative to the manifest) to a .ico file that becomes the produced setup.exe's Explorer icon. When omitted, the bundled default icon is used.

scope.description: Install scope: per-user, per-machine, or auto-resolve (T12).

install_dir.description: Optional install-dir override; may reference {app.*} / {scope_root} tokens (T13).

language.description: Optional fixed installer language tag (P9, gap G10) — the first link in the language-preference chain (installer.language -> /lang -> OS list -> en). An invalid tag is diagnosed (SIG0291).

options.description: Built-in configurable installer components (T8) plus app-defined custom components (P10, gap G11).

components.description: App-defined custom components (P10, gap G11) — the Inno [Tasks] equivalent. Each generates NO install step of its own; it exists only as option.<name> in the expression engine, gating arbitrary steps / step groups via their `when`. Rendered as checkboxes on the Options screen after the built-ins, in declared order.

screens.description: Declared custom wizard screens over parameters (T9).

vars.description: Declarative variables (P1, gap G1): each entry is `name: <expression>` evaluated once at install-session start, in dependency order, and exposed as var.<name> in `when` expressions / screen-field defaults and as a {var.<name>} brace token in step paths and args. Expressions use the closed `when` grammar plus the read-only data-retrieval functions registry_read/env/file_version/installed_version; a var referencing a secret parameter inherits secretness. A reference cycle is a pack error (SIG0270).

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks (P2, gap G2). Each phase is an ordered list of ordinary step records (typically run_program) that run OUTSIDE the rollback journal. WARNING: hooks have NO rollback obligations — their side effects are never recorded and never undone. A hook is governed only by its own `on_failure`: `fail` aborts the operation (the default for pre_install/pre_uninstall — the run stops before the journal opens / before the uninstall replays); `continue` logs and proceeds (the default for post_install/post_uninstall — the install is already committed and cannot be rolled back). Hook args may use {var.*} / {install_dir} tokens.

run_after_install.description: The program the Done screen's checked-by-default 'Launch <App>' checkbox starts, and the program a headless `/silent /launch` run starts (P2, gap G4). Always launched UNELEVATED — de-elevated to the user's medium-integrity token when the installer itself ran as admin.

path.description: Program to launch. May use {install_dir} / {var.*} / payload:// tokens.

args.description: Optional arguments; each may use the same tokens.

prerequisites.description: First-class prerequisite units (P5, gap G6) — the declarative equivalent of Burn's ExePackage + DetectCondition. Each runs BEFORE the transactional install body and the pre_install hooks (and before the rollback journal opens): its `detect` expression is evaluated (skip when already satisfied), otherwise the `source` installer is acquired and run, and `detect` is re-evaluated to confirm it took effect. WARNING: prerequisites are NEVER journaled and are NOT rolled back — a shared machine dependency (VC++ redist, .NET runtime) must not be undone. An exit code of 3010 flags reboot-required (Done-screen notice + silent exit code 3010).

app_mutex.description: Named mutexes the application creates while it is running (P6, gap G7) — the Inno `AppMutex` equivalent. Before touching the install directory, setup opens each name; a mutex that opens means the app is running and the install/uninstall is blocked. This complements the Restart Manager sweep, which also finds processes holding files open in the install directory even when no mutex is declared. Blocked runs: the wizard shows a 'Close applications' screen; `/silent` exits with a dedicated code unless `/closeapps` is supplied. Use the exact name the app passes to CreateMutex, including any `Global\` prefix.

parameters.description: Install-time / pack-time parameter declarations consumed by the wrapper installer (Sprint 5c).

screen.description: Optional wizard page label. Parameters that share a screen value are grouped onto the same Install Options screen in the wrapper installer. Parameters without a screen value land on a default 'Install Options' page after all named screens.

source.description: Dynamic options source. The wizard fetches `url` at install time, parses JSON, and populates a ComboBox with the items at `items_path` keyed by `value_property` / labelled by `label_property`.

install_steps.description: Main install-time step list executed by the wrapper installer (Sprint 5c). Per-step parameter shapes are validated by the typed deserializer.

pre_install.description: Steps executed before the main install_steps block.

post_install.description: Steps executed after the main install_steps block.

uninstall.description: Steps executed at the start of `setup.exe /Uninstall`, BEFORE the rollback journal replays. Lets the manifest tear down services / scheduled tasks / external scripts that the install journal doesn't cover.
